brief: The buyer and worker agree that a finalized GenLayer Bradbury testnet ruling will determine payment or refund of real OUSD held on Tempo mainnet. Internet Court relays the ruling. Explain how a requester selects an evaluator at task creation. Deliver a public Markdown file with the Taskmarket command and an explanation of the appeal window.

milestones.rubric: Approve a correct task create command naming the evaluator and a correct explanation of when the worker can appeal. Reject missing or incorrect work. Score 70–100 for a pass, 40–69 for uncertainty, 0–39 for a fail.
